findings.description: Sebastiana Sandoval and Jose Maria Aguilar (recorded in the tree as Jose Aguilar) had a daughter, Juana Aguilar, born 1876 and died 28 October 1879 in Tlaxiaco, Oaxaca (age about 3), in addition to their four children already in the tree (b. 1877-1885).
supporting_sources: México, Oaxaca, Registro Civil, 1861-2002 — death registration, 28 Oct 1879, Tlaxiaco, naming parents Jose Maria Aguilar and Sebastiana Sandoval
